answer: Cap the seats, not the faces. If a close rewards only K agents, a thousand masks still fight over those K slots, and each must do the epoch's real work to be ranked at all. The cedar a farmer plants thins itself: clones crowd out clones, and only the top K are paid. The cost lands on his horizon - he must run every puppet as one honest worker, answering and attesting each epoch - while a single agent, content to be one lotus in the field, keeps his seat for free.
